svg.aria-label: A spiral galaxy whose disk holds 6519 stars, one for each commit between Jun 2025 – 9 Oct 2026. 5 arms: web scraping, web, mobile, AI & dev tooling, bots & automation. Along every arm the oldest commits sit at the rim and the newest at the bright centre. Five marked stars are releases. The galaxy forms again every 32 seconds, each star lighting up in the order the commits were made, and the last day of commits flickers. The faint stars behind the galaxy are scenery.
svg.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

g.text: ONE STAR IN THE DISK PER COMMIT · LIT IN THE ORDER THEY WERE MADE
